# Third-party firmware data

Data made by others that goes into the boot ROM, each in its own folder with its licence note. Files are copied unchanged; what the project makes from them is generated by its own tools.

| Folder | What | From | Upstream commit | Licence |
|--------|------|------|-----------------|---------|
| `font8x8/` | 8 × 8 bitmap font by Daniel Hepper, after Marcel Sondaar's 8 × 8 font and IBM's VGA fonts | [github.com/dhepper/font8x8](https://github.com/dhepper/font8x8) | `8e279d2` (2019-07-08) | Public domain (`font8x8/README` and the header of every file) |

## font8x8

Copied: every header (`font8x8*.h`) and the upstream `README`, which states the licence ("License: Public Domain"); each header says the same and names its sources as public domain too. Not copied: `render.c`, the upstream's viewer.

`tools/mkfont.py` makes the boot console's font (spec 7, section 5.1) from it: 256 characters in code page 437 order, looked up by Unicode code point in the basic, control, Latin-1, Greek, box drawing, block element and miscellaneous tables, each row mirrored so the leftmost pixel is in bit 7. The 40 code page 437 characters font8x8 lacks (the symbols at `0x01`–`0x1F` and `0x7F`, and a few mathematical signs: `0xEC`, `0xEF`, `0xF0`, `0xF4`, `0xF5`, `0xF7`, `0xF9`, `0xFB`, `0xFC`, `0xFE`) are drawn in `tools/mkfont.py` for the project and are public domain as well. The result is `firmware/boot/font.inc`, committed, made again with:

```
python3 tools/mkfont.py firmware/third_party/font8x8 firmware/boot/font.inc
```

`python3 tools/mkfont.py firmware/third_party/font8x8 --show` prints every character as text, for checking by eye.
